contract: A stale cost estimate may not indefinitely replace the ordinary budgeted p8 continuation with raw constant-action multiplicity; after preserving the constant frontier, p8 gets the residual deadline and publishes only if complete.
summary: The f2205 upper-right Hard-empty stop was caused by the 80 current aimed bullets, but the terminal state was already an effect. Through f2187, completed p8 evidence retained stay, down, left, or down-left. At f2188 the cost estimator stopped attempting p8 and published the nine-way constant-h8 frontier instead. The first consequential error was f2191: all nine actions were still Hard-4 and constant-h8 safe, but p8 excluded the selected up action; the next decision selected up-right and entered the corner. Native medians on the full f2191 snapshot were 0.854 ms for Hard-4, 0.812 ms for shared h8 preparation, and 0.446 ms for p8, well inside the 12.5 ms budget. Removing all bullets and births preserves the constant-versus-replanning contradiction, so this source-defined boundary state is the minimal stable contract; the full artifact preserves the physical timing and aimed-volley evidence.
